subject: BUG: focus ring fails WCAG 2.2 on dark dashboard - fix: #4A90D9
body:
BUG FIX SPEC: Focus ring fails WCAG 2.2 on dark dashboard
Filed by: GD focus state audit

BUG
shared/styles.css :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-blue); }
--accent-blue = #1D42BA
#1D42BA on #161b22 (fd-card, dashboard bg) = 2.09:1
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.11 (Focus Appearance) requires focus indicator to have 3:1 contrast against adjacent color.
FAIL.

Impact: Kai cannot see keyboard focus when tabbing through the dashboard.

FIX
Option A (minimal): Add --accent-blue-on-dark to shared/styles.css :root and use it for focus-visible.
  --accent-blue-on-dark: #4A90D9;   /* 5.18:1 on #161b22 */
  :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-blue-on-dark); }

Option B (contextual): Keep --accent-blue for light-mode focus, override for dark in index.html.
  In index.html inline style or after shared/styles.css import:
  :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #4A90D9; }

RECOMMENDATION: Option A. shared/styles.css change is global and consistent.

NOTE: exam.html has its own :focus-visible at rgba(255,255,255,0.9) which passes at 14:1.
That rule does not need to change.

ACCEPT CRITERIA
- Tab through index.html dashboard. Every focused element shows visible ring.
- Focus ring contrast against card bg >= 3:1
- exam.html focus ring unchanged
